5th Ed Standard Title: The organisation has a well-defined registration and admission process.
Structural Reorganization: AAC.1 focused on displaying services in 4th Ed. In 5th Ed, AAC.2 explicitly mandates unique UHID across every encounter in objective element AAC.2.c.
EMR Field Impact: Requires permanent UHID field, admission timestamp, bed assignment, and demographic verification.

4th Ed Standard Title: Patients cared for by the organisation undergo an established initial assessment.
5th Ed Standard Title: Patients cared for by the organisation undergo an established initial assessment.
Structural Reorganization: In 4th Edition, Initial Assessment was AAC.4 (AAC.3 was Transfer/Referral). In 5th Edition, Initial Assessment is AAC.3. Code re-aligned.
EMR Field Impact: Separates 24-hour medical assessment timeframe (AAC.3.a) from immediate nursing assessment (AAC.3.b), nutritional screening (AAC.3.c), and pain screening (AAC.3.d).

4th Ed Standard Title: Regular reassessment (AAC.5) and Continuity of care (AAC.6)
5th Ed Standard Title: Continuity of care (AAC.4) and Regular reassessment (AAC.5)
Structural Reorganization: 5th Edition flipped the order: AAC.4 is Continuity of care, AAC.5 is Regular Reassessment. 4th Edition had Reassessment as AAC.5 and Continuity as AAC.6.
EMR Field Impact: Reassessment tab now displays historical baseline benchmarks and tracks pain response within 30-60 minutes.

5th Ed Standard Title: Safe process for transfer and referral (AAC.6) and Shift handover (COP.6.c)
Structural Reorganization: User provided AAC.5 for Handover. In 5th Edition, safe transfer/referral is AAC.6, while structured clinical handover is consolidated under nursing care COP.6.c.
EMR Field Impact: Requires structured SBAR format (Situation, Background, Assessment, Recommendation) with dual nurse/physician sign-offs.

5th Ed Standard Title: Uniform care to patients is provided in all settings of the organisation.
Structural Reorganization: Consolidated in 5th Edition under COP.1 with specific objective elements for individualized care plans and single composite medical chart.
EMR Field Impact: Requires unified care plans with prioritized problems, measurable targets, nursing interventions, and evaluation.

4th Ed Standard Title: Nursing care policies (Historical COP.3 in user reference)
5th Ed Standard Title: Nursing care provided in consonance with protocols (COP.6) and Medication administration (MOM.8)
Structural Reorganization: In 5th Edition, COP.3 is Ambulance Services. Nursing Care was moved to COP.6. Medication administration is governed under Management of Medication (MOM.8).
EMR Field Impact: Requires vital signs charting, 24-hour intake/output balance, eMAR with scheduled vs given times, and double-check for high-alert drugs.

4th Ed Standard Title: Resuscitation services are provided in accordance with scope.
Structural Reorganization: In 5th Edition, Resuscitation moved from COP.4 to COP.5. Facility disaster codes (Code Red, Yellow) moved to Facility Management (FMS.4).
EMR Field Impact: Requires capturing exact code announcement time, arrival time, response duration (< 3 mins), team members, and defibrillator log.

4th Ed Standard Title: Surgical services are guided by policies and procedures.
5th Ed Standard Title: Surgical services are provided in a consistent and safe manner.
Structural Reorganization: In 5th Edition, Surgical Care moved to COP.14 (COP.8 is Transfusion Services). Anaesthesia is separate under COP.13.
EMR Field Impact: Requires full WHO 3-Phase Surgical Safety Checklist (Sign In, Time Out, Sign Out) and operative notes documented prior to recovery transfer.

4th Ed Standard Title: The discharge process is planned and organized.
5th Ed Standard Title: The organisation has a defined process for discharge of patients.
Structural Reorganization: In 5th Edition, Discharge was moved from Care of Patients (COP.13) to Access, Assessment and Continuity of Care (AAC.7). In 5th Edition, COP.13 is Anaesthesia Services.
EMR Field Impact: Mandatory discharge summary issued at discharge with final diagnosis, treatment summary, follow-up advice, and electronic signature.

4th Ed Standard Title: Patient and family education is provided to empower them.
5th Ed Standard Title: Patient and family education is provided to empower them in decision making.
Structural Reorganization: Standard code remained PRE.4 across editions. 5th Edition strengthened requirement for assessing learning barriers and confirming return demonstration.
EMR Field Impact: Requires tracking learning barriers, education topics, teaching method codes (D, OD, W), outcome codes (RD, VU), and educator EID.

4th Ed Standard Title: Mechanism to address patient complaints and grievances.
5th Ed Standard Title: The organisation has a mechanism to address patient and family complaints and grievances.
Structural Reorganization: Code preserved across editions. 5th Edition added formal tracking of resolution timeframes and systematic root-cause review.
EMR Field Impact: Complaint logging, severity classification, investigation notes, CAPA, and resolution TAT.

4th Ed Standard Title: Implementation of infection control program in all areas.
5th Ed Standard Title: The organisation implements the infection prevention and control programme in all areas.
Structural Reorganization: Code preserved. 5th Edition strictly mandates WHO 5 Moments compliance measurement (Quality Indicator #45).
EMR Field Impact: Point-of-care sanitizer availability, monthly compliance percentage audits across doctors, nurses, and housekeeping.

5th Ed Standard Title: The organisation performs surveillance of healthcare-associated infections.
Structural Reorganization: Code preserved. 5th Edition mandates CDC/NHSN definitions with device days pooled daily as denominators.
EMR Field Impact: Daily device day logs (urinary catheter days, ventilator days, central line days) and CAUTI/CLABSI/VAP infection tracking.

4th Ed Standard Title: Biomedical waste managed in accordance with applicable rules.
5th Ed Standard Title: Biomedical waste is managed in accordance with statutory rules.
Structural Reorganization: Code preserved. 5th Edition updated reference to Bio-Medical Waste Management Rules 2016 (Schedule I color coding, barcode labels).
EMR Field Impact: 4-color segregation logging (Yellow, Red, White, Blue), barcoded tracking, daily weight records, CBWTF manifest.

4th Ed Standard Title: The organisation identifies and monitors key quality indicators.
5th Ed Standard Title: Clinical and managerial key performance indicators are monitored and analysed.
Structural Reorganization: In 4th Edition, KPIs were PSQ.3. In 5th Edition, Quality Indicators are Standard PSQ.4 (PSQ.3 is Leadership Support for Quality). Covers all 49 core indicators.
EMR Field Impact: Automated calculation of numerators and denominators from live EMR store data, trend graphs, and monthly reviews.

4th Ed Standard Title: The organisation implements a clinical safety program.
5th Ed Standard Title: The organisation implements a clinical safety program.
Structural Reorganization: In 4th Edition, Safety Program was PSQ.6. In 5th Edition, Patient Safety is Standard PSQ.2. PSQ.6 in 5th Edition is Quality Audits.
EMR Field Impact: Standardized Morse Fall Scale, Braden Pressure Ulcer Scale, Caprini VTE scale, plus near-miss and sentinel event logging.
